name: GTA V Frame Tick
description: Per-frame composition: input, streaming, movement, then the draw.

steps.comment: The input group is reused verbatim from quake3. It only produces move/look/jump/crouch intent, which is exactly what the q3.pm.* steps consume, so there is nothing GTA-specific to restate.

Pins the player at the spawn point until the ground under them has streamed in -- read on demand, that takes seconds, and unheld the player falls through the empty world. After the physics group, so it overrides this frame's movement; before streaming, so streaming centres on the spawn point.
Streaming runs after movement so it centres on the origin this frame produced rather than the last one's.
Spawns once, and only after a tile has streamed in: a car dropped into an empty world falls straight through.
F gets in and out of the nearest car, WASD drives, space brakes. Forces land a frame later than they are pressed, since the physics step already ran this frame.

Chase camera while seated. After vehicles_sync so it reads this frame's chassis, and before render_prepare so it overrides the first-person view camera.fps.update wrote -- which, seated, is from inside the roof.
Renders into an HDR target rather than straight to the swapchain, so the composite has something to antialias and tone map.

Before the tiles and at depth 1.0, so the city occludes it by depth test. Colours are linear: the composite applies ACES then gamma, which lifts them a long way. The horizon is also the city's fog colour -- the step publishes it -- so the two cannot drift into a band where the tiles run out.
Blits the scene target to the swapchain. Without this and the submit below, the draws land in a texture nobody presents and the window stays black.
What gta5.player.hold is waiting on, in the overlay; a blank once the ground is in, so the label goes away.
